partners.mechanism_chain: AGXT (HGNC:236) —DISRUPTS→ Glyoxylate Metabolism (R-HSA-70171); Glyoxylate Metabolism (R-HSA-70171) —DECREASES→ Glyoxylate (CHEBI:17700); Glyoxylate (CHEBI:17700) —LEADS_TO→ Nephrolithiasis (HP:0000077); ALDH4A1 (HGNC:337) —DISRUPTS→ Glyoxylate Metabolism (R-HSA-70171); Glyoxylate Metabolism (R-HSA-70171) —DECREASES→ Proline (CHEBI:15549); Proline (CHEBI:15549) —LEADS_TO→ Renal failure (HP:0000077); ALDH4A1 (HGNC:337) —DISRUPTS→ 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate (CHEBI:17934); 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate (CHEBI:17934) —LEADS_TO→ Renal failure (HP:0000077). Mutations in ALDH4A1 also lead to a loss-of-function, disrupting proline metabolism by impairing the conversion of 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate to glutamate. This leads to an accumulation of 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate and proline, contributing to renal failure. The convergence occurs at the level of disrupted metabolic pathways, specifically glyoxylate and proline metabolism, which are linked and can both contribute to renal pathology.
